notes: Priority 1 audit fixes, batch 1 (1.11.16, items 1.2-1.6): (1.2) sync locking — push_to_google, box_api_push_one and run_calendar_sync serialized under STATE_LOCK + a push-specific SYNC_LOCK, plus a per-box in-flight guard in push-one, so concurrent pushes can no longer create duplicate Google events or lose event_map updates. (1.3) deletion gap — push_to_google now resolves the Google event id from programme.uid_map / ical_map for pull-linked boxes instead of skipping them, so deleting a box deletes its Google event for every mapped box as v1.11.12 intended; GoogleNotFound still counts as removed and a failed delete keeps the mapping for retry. (1.4) 7-day token — invalid_grant now maps to a clear «توکن ۷روزه منقضی شد — دوباره وصل شو» message (bilingual via errText), the OAuth status warns when the refresh token is 6+ days old (token_refresh_expires_soon + days left), and done-pull errors are recorded in the sync log instead of a silent (0, 0). (1.5) minutesBetween — a zero-length box (start == end) is 0 minutes, not 1440; the edit form and the box API reject zero-length boxes. (1.6) one accuracy definition — accuracy = correct ÷ attempted everywhere (KPI, exam trend table, accuracy line chart, exam card) with a separate labelled coverage column (attempted ÷ total) in the trend table and on the exam card. No 1.1 (localhost auth) — user dismissed it as accepted risk.
